termination_scope: timeout default process group, no --foreground; TERM followed by KILL after 30 seconds
latch: Create dispatch_authorization.json exclusively before launching; its existence forbids automatic re-dispatch.
error_rule: Nonzero exit, missing/invalid receipts, incomplete source allocation or collection outside caps blocks inference; no replacement/retry.
output_rule: Raw directory must be absent immediately before one authorized dispatch; all source suffixes refuse overwrite.
post_run: Record tool session exit code and end time; verify no owned one_combat/xargs/timeout processes remain.
